items.title: THE TWIN BROTHER
items.premise:
Location: Courtroom

Judge: "Do you swear to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?"
Witness: "Yes."
Judge: "Where were you on the night of the robbery?"
Witness: "At home."
Judge: "Can anyone confirm that?"
Witness: "Yes. My Wi-Fi history."

Everyone turns toward him. Awkward silence.

items.title: THE HONEST WITNESS
items.premise:
Location: Courtroom

Judge: "Do you swear to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth?"
Witness: "Yes."
Judge: "Where were you on the night of the robbery?"
Witness: "At home."
Judge: "Can anyone confirm that?"
Witness: "Yes. My Wi-Fi history."

Everyone turns toward him. Awkward silence.

items.title: The excuse
items.premise:
Location: Courtroom

Judge: "Why did you steal the calendar?"
Defendant: "I needed to take a few days off."
Judge: "That's not funny."
Defendant: "Neither is your sentencing."

Judge slowly removes his glasses.

items.title: The Broken Clock
items.premise:
Location: Living room

Son: "Dad, the clock is broken."
Dad: "It's okay, son."
Son: "Why?"
Dad: "It will be right twice a day."

Son looks at the clock. Dad walks away proudly.

items.title: The remote control
items.premise:
Location: Living room

Wife: "Honey, have you seen the remote?"
Husband: "No."
Wife: "You were just holding it!"
Husband: "Well, I don't control everything."

Wife stares at him. Husband slowly hides the remote behind his back.

items.title: The diet
items.premise:
Location: Kitchen

Wife: "Are you on a diet?"
Husband: "Yes."
Wife: "Then why are you eating cake?"
Husband: "It's my cheat day."
Wife: "Every day?"
Husband: "I'm very committed to cheating."

Wife slowly puts down her fork.

items.title: The smart fridge
items.premise:
Location: Kitchen

Son: "Dad, our fridge is smart!"
Dad: "How?"
Son: "It keeps telling me to close the door."
Dad: "That's because it's trying to save your future."
Son: "What?"
Dad: "Electricity bills, son."

Son stares blankly.

items.title: The lazy dad
items.premise:
Location: Bedroom

Wife: "Can you get up and turn off the light?"
Husband: "I'm already comfortable."
Wife: "It's just two steps away!"
Husband: "Exactly. Two steps too many."

Wife turns off the light herself.
Husband: "See? Teamwork."

Wife stares at him.

items.title: The Online Order Confidence
items.premise: Me: "I bought clothes online without checking the size chart." Package arrives. Me tries on shirt: it fits like a doll shirt. Me: "I am now a stylish fashion model for ants."

items.title: The Heavy Feather
items.premise: Riddle Master: "What gets wetter the more it dries?" Contestant: "A sponge?" Riddle Master: "A towel!" Contestant blinks: "Wait... that actually makes total sense."

items.title: The Building Mystery
items.premise: Riddle Master: "What has many keys but can't open a single lock?" Contestant: "A key ring?" Riddle Master: "A piano!" Contestant slowly air-pianos in defeat.

items.title: The Camera-On Panic
items.premise: Boss: "Let's all turn on our cameras for a quick photo!" Employee (wearing pajamas with a formal shirt taped to front): "My camera just broke, sir!" Boss: "We can see your shirt slipping." Employee freezes.

items.title: Friday at 4:58 PM
items.premise: Worker packing bag at 4:58 PM. Co-worker: "Did you check Slack?" Worker: "I cannot read after 4:55 PM, it's medical." Co-worker approves and nods silently.

items.title: NPC In Real Life
items.premise: Player walks up to friend. Friend repeats the same dialogue while walking into a wall: "Good morning! Fine weather today!" Player: "Are you bugged?" Friend: "Good morning! Fine weather today!" Player slowly walks backwards away.

items.title: Very Demure Water Break
items.premise: Influencer takes a tiny sip from a massive 1-gallon water bottle with pinky out: "Very mindful, very demure." Friend: "You've been holding that bottle for 2 hours and took 1 milliliter." Influencer winks silently.
